lines.text: Eight o'clock. Two mugs out. And she cancels.
lines.say: [deadpan] Eight o'clock. Two mugs out. [frustrated] And she cancels.

lines.text: So it reads her part. You go script, then just the cues, then nothing.
lines.say: [conspiratorial] So it reads her part. [playful] You go script, then just the cues, [excited] then nothing.

lines.text: Line? It feeds you the next few words.
lines.say: [mischievously] Line? [upbeat] It feeds you the next few words.

lines.text: Ghost Light. Built by a working actor.
lines.say: [upbeat] Ghost Light. Built by a working actor.

source.app_check: actorrise main: lib/rehearsal/book.ts, BOOKS = Script / Cues / Off book; partner lines always shown; Cues keeps the first words (CUE_WORDS 2); off book the words fill in as said; 'line' said out loud (or the Line! button) shows the next few words, marked as given. Ghost Light repo not reachable from this run, so the close is ActorRise (web) rather than Ghost Light.
source.data: No monologue, title or quote on screen: the scene is drawn as word bars.
